title: Sales by Customer and At Risk at zero show an empty chart outline
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. Browser: you use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. Location: you are in a location (workplace) with nothing in it: no work order, invoice, credit or clocked time (for example ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu with ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop selected (Sales by Customer on Last 12 Months, At Risk on 120 Days).
  2. Read both headlines and their supporting lines.
  3. Look at the trend-line area of both tiles.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Sales by Customer keeps its real-zero headline "0 customers" and At Risk Customers keeps "0".
  • Step 2: The line under Sales by Customer reads "Top: None" and the line under At Risk Customers reads "$0.00 (12mo) · 0 customers". Neither line disappears because of the outline.
  • Step 3: Every month is zero, so instead of a flat line along the bottom each tile shows a dashed outline with a small line-chart icon in its middle, under the headline.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9577 (Story 5, Count Tiles, Sales by Customer and At Risk Customers); story SV-9576 (Story 4, KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v50 (16 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 16 Oct 2026, Story 5 (S5-R16, S5-R3, S5-R9), which applies Story 4's S4-R12 to S4-R18, S4-E2 and S4-E3. Product owner answers: Chris Ward, Dashboard question sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10Bgu1k2Dzxd2kAvIlEBVWSDIIs00G55VgFoImMU9SjY/edit), answer 9 (14 Oct 2026) and answer 18 (16 Oct 2026). Design canvas boards 15_Empty_Design and 15_Empty_Now (row 15).

The design's row 15 (re-shared 14 Oct 2026) shows no line under Sales by Customer when it reads 0 customers. Chris Ward's answer 18 (16 Oct 2026, question sheet above) and the PRD from version 49 (S5-R3) say the line reads “Top: None”. This case follows the later decision, which we take as prevailing.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R16: “The two count tiles follow S4-R12 to S4-R18, S4-E2 and S4-E3: with nothing to plot, they show the empty-chart placeholder in place of their sparkline.”
  • S4-R13: “A tile also shows the empty-chart placeholder when every point that has a value is zero.”
  • S4-E2: “A tile whose headline is a real zero, such as "$0.00" on Revenue, keeps that headline and shows the placeholder under it.”
  • S5-R3: “The Sales by Customer tile shows a supporting line reading "Top: {top customer name}". With no customer in the range it reads “Top: None”, so the line never disappears.”
  • S5-R9: “The At Risk Customers tile shows a supporting line reading "${revenue} (12mo) · {count} customers" when no customer or more than one customer is at risk. With none at risk it reads "$0.00 (12mo) · 0 customers", so the line never disappears.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026, before the expected results changed on 16 Oct 2026; the changed results have not yet been checked against a build.
